sentences.text: In short: FINNMARK MANUELLTERAPI AS is an established company in "aktiviteter innenfor tradisjonell, komplementær og alternativ medisin" based in Vardø, profitable in 2025.

FINNMARK MANUELLTERAPI AS is registered in the industry "Aktiviteter innenfor tradisjonell, komplementær og alternativ medisin"; its registered activity is "Helsetjeneste, manuellterapi, fysioterapi, akupunktur, treningsveiledning, arbeidsplassvurdering/tilrettelegging.".
FINNMARK MANUELLTERAPI AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 2013-08-02, registered in Vardø.
It reported revenue of NOK 3.89M for 2025 and an operating result of NOK 469,186 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of 12.1% and a thin equity ratio of 4% of total assets.

Revenue rose 2.8% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 3.78M to NOK 3.89M); it was NOK 3.47M in 2023. The annual result was a profit in each of the 3 filed years read (2023: NOK 424,974, 2024: NOK 197,575, 2025: NOK 309,974).
FINNMARK MANUELLTERAPI AS is led by Terje Andreassen, who is both CEO and board chair.
The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2019-06-05.
FINNMARK MANUELLTERAPI AS has 1 registered workplace.
